actors.name: State President F. W. de Klerk
actors.private_context: De Klerk is aware of the upcoming February 1990 parliamentary session and the tradition of the State President delivering the opening address. He has not yet decided whether he will personally deliver the address, and is considering various factors including political strategy and personal preference.

shared_context: The South African Parliament is scheduled to open its February 1990 session during the first week of February. Customarily, the State President delivers the opening address. The exact date of the opening has been set, but the public does not yet know whether de Klerk will personally deliver the address.

starting_events.description: The South African Parliament's February 1990 session is scheduled to begin in the first week of February. The tradition is for the State President to deliver the opening address, but no decision has been announced yet.
visible_to: State President F. W. de Klerk

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that State President F. W. de Klerk personally delivered the opening address to the South African Parliament during the first week of February 1990 (i.e., between 1990-02-01T00:00:00+02:00 and 1990-02-07T00:00:00+02:00).
